tiles.name: Total OneTrust Events
tiles.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as "Total Events" FROM useraction WHERE name STARTSWITH "one-trust.service.ts "

tiles.name: OneTrust Failures
tiles.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as "Failures" FROM useraction WHERE name STARTSWITH "one-trust.service.ts " AND (name LIKE "%failure%" OR name LIKE "%dead flow%" OR name LIKE "%error%")

tiles.name: SDK Init Success
tiles.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as "SDK Init Success" FROM useraction WHERE name STARTSWITH "one-trust.service.ts " AND name LIKE "%handlesdkinitsuccess%"

tiles.name: SDK Init Failures
tiles.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as "SDK Init Failures" FROM useraction WHERE name STARTSWITH "one-trust.service.ts " AND name LIKE "%startsdk failure callback%"

tiles.name: OneTrust Events Over Time
tiles.query: SELECT usersession.osFamily, COUNT(*) FROM useraction WHERE name STARTSWITH "one-trust.service.ts " AND usersession.osFamily IN ("iOS", "Android") GROUP BY usersession.osFamily

tiles.name: Failures Over Time
tiles.query: SELECT usersession.osFamily, COUNT(*) FROM useraction WHERE name STARTSWITH "one-trust.service.ts " AND (name LIKE "%failure%" OR name LIKE "%dead flow%" OR name LIKE "%error%") AND usersession.osFamily IN ("iOS", "Android") GROUP BY usersession.osFamily

tiles.name: Init Native
tiles.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as "Init Native" FROM useraction WHERE name STARTSWITH "one-trust.service.ts " AND name LIKE "%initializenativeonetrust%"

tiles.name: Start SDK
tiles.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as "Start SDK" FROM useraction WHERE name STARTSWITH "one-trust.service.ts " AND name LIKE "%startonetrustsdk%"

tiles.name: Init Success
tiles.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as "Init Success" FROM useraction WHERE name STARTSWITH "one-trust.service.ts " AND name LIKE "%handlesdkinitsuccess%"

tiles.name: Init Failure
tiles.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as "Init Failure" FROM useraction WHERE name STARTSWITH "one-trust.service.ts " AND name LIKE "%startsdk failure%"

tiles.name: Register Listeners
tiles.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as "Register Listeners" FROM useraction WHERE name STARTSWITH "one-trust.service.ts " AND name LIKE "%registeroteventlisteners%"

tiles.name: Get Consent
tiles.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as "Get Consent" FROM useraction WHERE name STARTSWITH "one-trust.service.ts " AND name LIKE "%getconsentstatusforcategory%"

tiles.name: Sync Webview
tiles.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as "Sync Webview" FROM useraction WHERE name STARTSWITH "one-trust.service.ts " AND name LIKE "%syncotwebviewwithmobconsent%"

tiles.name: Sync+Start Web
tiles.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as "Sync+Start Web" FROM useraction WHERE name STARTSWITH "one-trust.service.ts " AND name LIKE "%syncconsentandstartwebot%"

tiles.name: Update Plugins
tiles.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as "Update Plugins" FROM useraction WHERE name STARTSWITH "one-trust.service.ts " AND name LIKE "%updateotconsentsplugins%"

tiles.name: Dead Flows
tiles.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as "Dead Flows" FROM useraction WHERE name STARTSWITH "one-trust.service.ts " AND name LIKE "%dead flow%"

tiles.name: Top OneTrust Events by Count
tiles.query: SELECT name as "Event", COUNT(*) as "Count" FROM useraction WHERE name STARTSWITH "one-trust.service.ts " GROUP BY name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

tiles.name: OS Family Split
tiles.query: SELECT usersession.osFamily as "OS", COUNT(*) as "Events" FROM useraction WHERE name STARTSWITH "one-trust.service.ts " AND usersession.osFamily IN ("iOS", "Android") GROUP BY usersession.osFamily

tiles.name: Events by App Version
tiles.query: SELECT usersession.appVersion as "App Version", COUNT(*) as "Events" FROM useraction WHERE name STARTSWITH "one-trust.service.ts " GROUP BY usersession.appVersion ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

tiles.name: All Failure / Dead Flow Events
tiles.query: SELECT name as "Event", usersession.osFamily as "OS", usersession.appVersion as "App Version", COUNT(*) as "Count" FROM useraction WHERE name STARTSWITH "one-trust.service.ts " AND (name LIKE "%failure%" OR name LIKE "%dead flow%" OR name LIKE "%error%") GROUP BY name, usersession.osFamily, usersession.appVersion ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
